messages:
Leah: Heads-up: sample-app CI started failing type checks after the autogen change that emits enums as plain strings when unknown values are allowed.
Leah: mypy output:
```
src/models/order.py:37: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "str | None", variable has type "OrderStatus | None")  [assignment]
Found 1 error in 1 file
```
Owen: I saw that. The generator now emits `status: Optional[str]` for open enums which is safer runtime-wise but breaks static typing expectations.
Priya: From a runtime POV we want to preserve unknown values as raw strings so clients don't crash. But typing should communicate both possibilities.
Leah: proposal: emit `Optional[Union[OrderStatus, str]]` and update validator to coerce to enum when possible, otherwise keep string. That should satisfy mypy/pyright and be explicit to callers.
Owen: Agree. Two small compatibility notes: 1) avoid PEP 604 unions to not force future imports for older supported Py versions; 2) import `Union`/`Optional` from typing in generated files when used.
Priya: Also add a short comment in the generated file explaining why we keep raw strings for unknown enum values so downstream maintainers understand it's intentional.
Sam: I'll make a tiny change to the generator: emit `Optional[Union[EnumName, str]]`, add `pre=True` validator that tries `EnumName(v)` and returns v on ValueError, and update sample-app typing test to accept `OrderStatus | str`.
CI-bot: sample-app/mypy-check failed on branch enum-fix-1966001234  https://ci.internal/runs/5089  logs attached.
Leah: can you also add a test that simulates unknown enum payload from server (e.g., "DEPRECATED_STATUS") to ensure round-trip works? We had regressions where validator threw and caused runtime errors.
Sam: yes, adding test + changelog note. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autogen/pull/4101 
Owen: when you open the PR add a short note about pyright compatibility; some customers run pyright strictly.
Sam: done. PR includes generator change, updated sample-app test, and a generated-file comment.
CI-bot: PR 4101 CI: all checks passed and merged into main at 1966001325.
Leah: great, thanks. after merge we'll run a quick smoke across quickstart and playground repos.
Priya: thanks everyone, this should reduce onboarding friction for users who hit unknown enum values.
Owen: marking this thread resolved on my end. :ok_hand:
